title: Dashboard design for someone who has thirty seconds

videos.script: It is Monday morning. Paulo opens the operations dashboard between two meetings. He has thirty seconds. {{monday}} In those thirty seconds he wants three answers. Are we all right? If not, where? And did anything change since last week? {{three}} Faro's dashboard had fourteen tiles, two gauges and a map of the state. It answered none of the three in thirty seconds. And the one number that mattered most was not on it at all. {{faro}} This lesson redesigns that dashboard for its real reader. The most important number goes where the eye lands first. Every number gets something to be compared with. {{redesign}} And it ends with the difference between a dashboard and a presentation. A dashboard watches. It does not argue. {{watch}}
